name: Wallis and Futuna

findings.controller: Alcatel Submarine Networks (Nokia group), Tui-Samoa turnkey supplier
findings.local_actor: Territory of Wallis and Futuna (Administration supérieure); Samoa Submarine Cable Company (SSCC), commercial operator
findings.financier: AFD (EUR 13m non-sovereign bridge loan pending EU grant); European Union; French State
findings.summary: Wallis and Futuna were added as branches of SSCC's Tui-Samoa cable, built by Alcatel Submarine Networks under an October 2016 turnkey contract; the cable reached Wallis on 19 November and Futuna on 28 November 2017, replacing satellite-only capacity.
findings.analyst_inference: French/EU controllers are 'third' (PYF/NCL convention). ASN is named as Tui-Samoa supplier by SSCC and Outremers360; neither states separately who built the Wallis/Futuna branch segments, so branch supplier is inferred from the system contract. SSCC release coded S1 as the project company's notice; a reviewer could treat it as S4. Tier 4: landings and connections documented, but contemporaneous sources expected commercial service from spring/March 2018 and activation was not confirmed in this run. AFD (EUR 13m) and Outremers360 (EUR 11m) disagree on the AFD amount; EUR not converted, so USD null. Pre-2020; current status not checked.

findings.local_actor: Service des Postes et Télécommunications (SPT) de Wallis-et-Futuna, operator
findings.summary: AFD lent XPF 370m from September 2014 to finance the territory's first mobile network, a 3G network upgradeable to 4G run by the SPT and designed to keep local service if satellite links fail; AFD lists the project as completed.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: the radio/core equipment vendor is not named in the opened source, so the equipment-rule controller is unknown; SPT is a territorial service (domestic) but is the operator, not the vendor. Tier 4 (financing closed); AFD's 'completed' status suggests operation but commissioning was not separately confirmed. XPF not converted. Pre-2020; still_current not checked.
